meta.description: FF14 action (skill) descriptions harvested for the FF14 term DB. Companion file to ff14_term_db.json: the main DB stays name-focused; descriptions live here, keyed by XIVAPI Action row_id.
meta.source: XIVAPI v2 (beta.xivapi.com/api/1), Action sheet, transient Description field. One-time harvest; reading sites must use this file (or the future local XIVAPI mirror on cocoa-4), never XIVAPI at runtime.
meta.scope: Prototype harvest: all PvE actions of SGE / WHM / CNJ plus every icon-mapped action name referenced by the job-sge and job-whm blog articles. Designed to extend to all jobs / all sheets; the eventual canonical source is the full local XIVAPI mirror (~/xivapi-mirror on cocoa-4), from which this file can be regenerated without network access.
meta.update_policy: Same as ff14_term_db.json: after the initial collection, only per-patch additions/changes are fetched. All languages XIVAPI offers (ja/en/de/fr) are stored.
